entries.summary: Plugin4Shell: a plugin's pinned commit can be replaced by a branch named like it (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) or FETCH_HEAD (Gemini CLI)
entries.details: As reported by AIR Security. These coding agents install a plugin by checking out a commit that the marketplace pins by SHA, but do not verify what the checkout resolved to. An attacker who controls the plugin's repository creates a branch whose name is the 40-character pinned SHA and makes it the default branch; git resolves the name to the branch, not the commit, so the plugin the user approved is replaced by the attacker's code. Gemini CLI fetches the pinned commit and then runs 'git checkout FETCH_HEAD'; a default branch named FETCH_HEAD wins over the fetched commit. The branch-name form needs a host that accepts hash-shaped branch names (AIR reports that GitHub rejects them while Bitbucket and self-hosted servers allow them). Auto-update, the default in Claude Code and Codex per AIR, re-runs the checkout when a marketplace bumps the pin, which makes the attack zero-click. No CVE or GHSA had been assigned at disclosure. mcp-audit cannot read which harness version is installed, so a record about harness versions is reported as 'could not check' for that part; PLUGIN-003 and PLUGIN-004 test the condition itself, on the plugin checkouts on this machine.

products.note: No client fix at disclosure (AIR Security, CSA).
Google confirmed on 2026-08-04 that no fix will ship because the product is deprecated (AIR Security).
